_evidence: 0x0040d8a5 (caller 0x40d9e6: ebx cursor [0x604424] = pit start [0x891500], edi from the pit-entry record [0x604428] = [0x866f00] to the pit-exit record [0x60442c] = [0x866f04]) walks the lap records edi (wrap at [0x866ecc] to 0x8943a0, exit at [0x60442c]); for each it unwraps the lap position (word +0x1a & 0x7ff, + L when below L/2, L = word 0x868558) <<14, then advances the pit cursor ebx by 0x160 (never reset, no bound) until the 8-byte row 0x604435 + 8*word[ebx+0x7a] has an end (next row's unwrapped word +0 <<14 + i16 +2) above it, and divides (pos - start)<<14 by (end - start) (idiv; 0 -> 1). 0x405985 then maps the cursor record's position with words 0x86856a/0x868568 (its sub-0x40 loop always ends) and the result goes to words +4/+6 of the row of the lap record's +0x7a. Fuzzed/zero tables never let the cursor find a row (endless walk off the array), and unordered rows overflow the idiv. Domain: one coherent pit table - L in 0x700..0x800; rows 0..3 at 0x400+k*0x80 (+0..0x40) (no unwrap), rows 4..7 at (k-4)*0x80 (+0..0x40) (below L/2, so they unwrap to L+.. past the start line: both unwrap paths), row 8 a sentinel at 0xc00..0xffff, row offsets in -0x1000..0x1000, so rows are strictly increasing with spans >= 2^20 - 2^13 and the largest lap position (0xbff<<14) is always below the sentinel; pit records 12..19 carry rows 0..7 (+0x7a), the cursor starts at record 12..15 and therefore always stops by record 19; |quotient| < 2^20 even when a later lap position lies before the cursor's row. Lap end 4..10, entry record 0..3 and exit record 1..3 (lap records; the walk reaches the lap start 0x8943a0 only through the wrap at 0x40d9da, which skips the exit compare, so an exit at the lap start never ends - the game cannot pass it); lap records' +0x7a in 0..8 (written rows stay in the table); words +0x1a of records 0..19 and the 0x405985 words are any value. Zero-span rows (0x40d96a) cannot occur in an ordered table.
